notes.title: First month update using Godot!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=IKsjffM-Y60;full][/previewyoutube]
Was a tough 1 month transition from Unity to Godot! Settled down now and have a better understanding on how Godot works ~ UI, Node structure, Lifecycle, GDScript!

YouTube tutorials, documentation and code samples really helped! This is what we've done so far with me doing 2-3 hours of after office game development using Godot 4.1.
[list]
[*] Character movement and animation now complete
[*] Character attack animation now complete
[*] Tilemap structure now complete with better understanding on how Godot arranges tiles and the features it provides
[*] Enemy simple chase player AI now complete
[/list]
Thanks to [url=https://www.facebook.com/dythrw]Dyethrow PIXEL[/url] for the awesome pixel art.
